statement: Let vals(l) be the sequence of node values of l from head to tail: vals(Nil) = [] and vals(Cons(v, t)) = v :: vals(t). Say that a value v occurs in nums iff there exists an index i with 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] = v. The function returns a result r (i.e., modified_list nums head = Ok r) and vals(r) is exactly the sequence obtained from vals(head) by deleting every element v for which v occurs in nums, preserving the relative order of the remaining elements. Formally, vals(r) = filter (fun v => not (v occurs in nums)) (vals(head)), where filter keeps exactly the elements satisfying the predicate.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100000; for every i, j with 0 <= i < j < len(nums), nums[i] != nums[j]; 1 <= len(vals(head)) <= 100000; for every value v in vals(head), 1 <= v <= 100000; and there exists an index j with 0 <= j < len(vals(head)) such that vals(head)[j] does not occur in nums (i.e., there is no i with 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] = vals(head)[j]).

statement: For every nums and head satisfying the preconditions, there exists a list r such that modified_list nums head = Ok r; the function never returns Err on these inputs.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100000; for every i, j with 0 <= i < j < len(nums), nums[i] != nums[j]; 1 <= len(vals(head)) <= 100000; for every value v in vals(head), 1 <= v <= 100000; and there exists an index j with 0 <= j < len(vals(head)) such that vals(head)[j] does not occur in nums (i.e., there is no i with 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] = vals(head)[j]).

statement: The function returns a result r (modified_list nums head = Ok r) and for every value v that occurs in vals(r), v does not occur in nums (i.e., there is no index i with 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] = v).
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100000; for every i, j with 0 <= i < j < len(nums), nums[i] != nums[j]; 1 <= len(vals(head)) <= 100000; for every value v in vals(head), 1 <= v <= 100000; and there exists an index j with 0 <= j < len(vals(head)) such that vals(head)[j] does not occur in nums (i.e., there is no i with 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] = vals(head)[j]).

statement: The function returns a result r and for every integer v that does not occur in nums, the number of occurrences of v in vals(r) equals the number of occurrences of v in vals(head).
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100000; for every i, j with 0 <= i < j < len(nums), nums[i] != nums[j]; 1 <= len(vals(head)) <= 100000; for every value v in vals(head), 1 <= v <= 100000; and there exists an index j with 0 <= j < len(vals(head)) such that vals(head)[j] does not occur in nums (i.e., there is no i with 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] = vals(head)[j]).

statement: The function returns a result r and vals(r) is a subsequence of vals(head): there exist indices i_0 < i_1 < ... < i_{k-1} with 0 <= i_0 and i_{k-1} < len(vals(head)) such that for every j with 0 <= j < k, vals(r)[j] = vals(head)[i_j], where k = len(vals(r)).
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100000; for every i, j with 0 <= i < j < len(nums), nums[i] != nums[j]; 1 <= len(vals(head)) <= 100000; for every value v in vals(head), 1 <= v <= 100000; and there exists an index j with 0 <= j < len(vals(head)) such that vals(head)[j] does not occur in nums (i.e., there is no i with 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] = vals(head)[j]).

statement: The function returns a result r and len(vals(r)) equals the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(vals(head)) such that vals(head)[i] does not occur in nums.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100000; for every i, j with 0 <= i < j < len(nums), nums[i] != nums[j]; 1 <= len(vals(head)) <= 100000; for every value v in vals(head), 1 <= v <= 100000; and there exists an index j with 0 <= j < len(vals(head)) such that vals(head)[j] does not occur in nums (i.e., there is no i with 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] = vals(head)[j]).

statement: The function returns a result r and r is not Nil; equivalently, len(vals(r)) >= 1.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100000; for every i, j with 0 <= i < j < len(nums), nums[i] != nums[j]; 1 <= len(vals(head)) <= 100000; for every value v in vals(head), 1 <= v <= 100000; and there exists an index j with 0 <= j < len(vals(head)) such that vals(head)[j] does not occur in nums (i.e., there is no i with 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] = vals(head)[j]).

statement: The function returns a result r and, since r is non-empty, its first value vals(r)[0] is the first value in vals(head) that does not occur in nums. That is, vals(r)[0] = vals(head)[i] where i is the smallest index with 0 <= i < len(vals(head)) and vals(head)[i] does not occur in nums.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100000; for every i, j with 0 <= i < j < len(nums), nums[i] != nums[j]; 1 <= len(vals(head)) <= 100000; for every value v in vals(head), 1 <= v <= 100000; and there exists an index j with 0 <= j < len(vals(head)) such that vals(head)[j] does not occur in nums (i.e., there is no i with 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] = vals(head)[j]).

statement: The function returns a result r and, since r is non-empty, its last value vals(r)[len(vals(r))-1] is the last value in vals(head) that does not occur in nums. That is, vals(r)[len(vals(r))-1] = vals(head)[i] where i is the largest index with 0 <= i < len(vals(head)) and vals(head)[i] does not occur in nums.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100000; for every i, j with 0 <= i < j < len(nums), nums[i] != nums[j]; 1 <= len(vals(head)) <= 100000; for every value v in vals(head), 1 <= v <= 100000; and there exists an index j with 0 <= j < len(vals(head)) such that vals(head)[j] does not occur in nums (i.e., there is no i with 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] = vals(head)[j]).

statement: There exist lists r1 and r2 such that modified_list nums1 head = Ok r1 and modified_list nums2 head = Ok r2, and r1 = r2 (equivalently vals(r1) = vals(r2)).
preconditions: nums1 and nums2 each satisfy the problem constraints: 1 <= len(nums1), len(nums2) <= 100000; all elements of nums1 and nums2 lie in [1, 100000] and are distinct within each slice; head satisfies 1 <= len(vals(head)) <= 100000 with all node values in [1, 100000]; there is at least one node value in head that does not occur in nums1 (equivalently, not in nums2); and for every integer v, v occurs in nums1 if and only if v occurs in nums2.

statement: The function returns a result r and for every integer v, the number of occurrences of v in vals(r) is less than or equal to the number of occurrences of v in vals(head).
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100000; for every i, j with 0 <= i < j < len(nums), nums[i] != nums[j]; 1 <= len(vals(head)) <= 100000; for every value v in vals(head), 1 <= v <= 100000; and there exists an index j with 0 <= j < len(vals(head)) such that vals(head)[j] does not occur in nums (i.e., there is no i with 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] = vals(head)[j]).

statement: Let vals(l) be the sequence of node values of l from head to tail. The function returns a result r and there exist sequences A and B such that vals(head) is the interleaving of A and B that preserves the original order, B = vals(r), and A is exactly the subsequence of vals(head) consisting of those values v for which v occurs in nums (i.e., A is obtained from vals(head) by keeping only the elements v with v occurring in nums, in their original order).
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100000; for every i, j with 0 <= i < j < len(nums), nums[i] != nums[j]; 1 <= len(vals(head)) <= 100000; for every value v in vals(head), 1 <= v <= 100000; and there exists an index j with 0 <= j < len(vals(head)) such that vals(head)[j] does not occur in nums (i.e., there is no i with 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] = vals(head)[j]).
